question:
Read the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2de26cd835e76d426d3d11730d3b1691dc6c519305afc83bb9a717baa287d608.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Middle number = (Sum of two vertical numbers) + (Product of two horizontal numbers)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aa534c4be2cd48e9f4ae83fb80267fd25240b76360d1b84747983292de55d9c.png] 

→ 22 = (6 + 6) + (2 × 5) 

→ 22 = 12 + 10

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/689e05c899a8997bb076e3cbef5cae850bb11585fe3aefaeb9380eee45913684.png] 

→ ? = (5 + 9) + (4 × 5)

→ ? = 14 + 20 = 34

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
